ex.en: After the exam we compared the answers we'd written.
ex.zh: 考完試後，我們對了一下彼此寫的答案。

ex.en: I'll have exams right after the summer holidays.
ex.zh: 暑假一結束我就要考試了。

ex.en: You needn't be ashamed because you failed the exam.
ex.zh: 你雖然考試沒過，但也不必覺得丟臉。

exam.en: a formal test of what you know or can do

ex.en: They conducted a series of experiments under zero gravity.
ex.zh: 他們在無重力狀態下做了一系列實驗。

ex.en: Let's first talk about the experiments done in the laboratory.
ex.zh: 我們先來談談在實驗室裡做的實驗。

ex.en: This invention was the result of years of patient experiment.
ex.zh: 這項發明是多年耐心實驗的成果。

experiment.en: a scientific test done to learn something or to try an idea

ex.en: As far as I could make out, he was experimenting with new methods.
ex.zh: 據我所知，他正在嘗試新的方法。

ex.en: She likes to experiment with new recipes.
ex.zh: 她喜歡嘗試新食譜。

experiment.en: to try new things to see what happens or what works

ex.en: Most of the words are faded, but it's still possible to extrapolate the meaning from these sentences.
ex.zh: 大部分的字都褪色了，但還是可以從這些句子推斷出意思。

ex.en: We can extrapolate future sales from past data.
ex.zh: 我們可以從過去的資料推估未來的銷量。

extrapolate.en: to guess something new from facts that you already know

ex.en: The manual includes explanatory notes for each step.
ex.zh: 手冊每個步驟都附有說明註解。

ex.en: Please read the explanatory leaflet before use.
ex.zh: 使用前請先閱讀說明單張。

explanatory.en: giving reasons or details to make something clear

ex.en: The magazine has an exclusive interview with the CEO.
ex.zh: 這本雜誌獨家專訪了執行長。

ex.en: This offer is exclusive to our members.
ex.zh: 這項優惠僅限會員享有。

ex.en: They stayed at an exclusive resort in Bali.
ex.zh: 他們住在峇里島一家高級度假村。

ex.en: It's a very exclusive private club.
ex.zh: 那是一個非常高級的私人俱樂部。

exclusive.en: expensive and only for rich or special people

ex.en: We need someone with expertise in marketing.
ex.zh: 我們需要具備行銷專業的人。

ex.en: Thanks to her technical expertise, the project succeeded.
ex.zh: 多虧她的技術專長，專案才順利成功。

expertise.en: special skill or knowledge in a particular subject

ex.en: Students can apply for a fee exemption.
ex.zh: 學生可以申請免繳費用。

ex.en: This product qualifies for a tax exemption.
ex.zh: 這項產品符合免稅資格。

exemption.en: permission not to do or pay something that others must

ex.en: Check the expiration date before you buy milk.
ex.zh: 買牛奶前要先看有效期限。

ex.en: The contract's expiration is next March.
ex.zh: 這份合約明年三月到期。

ex.en: Please renew your passport before its expiration.
ex.zh: 請在護照到期前換發。

expiration.en: the end of the time that something can be used or is valid

ex.en: Excessive choice results in the inability to choose.
ex.zh: 選擇太多反而讓人無法選擇。

ex.en: The government's expenditures are a bit excessive.
ex.zh: 政府的支出有點過高。

ex.en: The hotel charged an excessive fee for Wi-Fi.
ex.zh: 那家飯店的 Wi-Fi 收費太高了。

excessive.en: much more than is needed or reasonable

ex.en: The hotel provides exceptional service.
ex.zh: 這家飯店的服務非常出色。

ex.en: She is an exceptional student.
ex.zh: 她是個非常優秀的學生。

ex.en: Refunds are given only in exceptional cases.
ex.zh: 只有在特殊情況下才會退款。

ex.en: Under exceptional circumstances, we can extend the deadline.
ex.zh: 在特殊情況下，我們可以延長期限。

exceptional.en: unusual and happening only in special cases

ex.en: We tried some exotic fruits at the night market.
ex.zh: 我們在夜市吃了一些異國水果。

ex.en: She loves traveling to exotic places.
ex.zh: 她喜歡去充滿異國風情的地方旅行。

exotic.en: unusual and interesting because it comes from a faraway foreign place

ex.en: He won the prize for excellence in all subjects.
ex.zh: 他因為各科表現優異而得獎。

ex.en: The company is known for its excellence in customer service.
ex.zh: 這家公司以卓越的客戶服務聞名。

ex.en: She received an award for academic excellence.
ex.zh: 她因學業成績優異而獲獎。

excellence.en: the quality of being very good

ex.en: This offer is available exclusively to our members.
ex.zh: 這項優惠僅限會員享有。

ex.en: The store sells exclusively organic products.
ex.zh: 這家店只賣有機產品。

exclusively.en: only, and not including anyone or anything else

ex.en: Tom used a fire extinguisher to try and put the fire out.
ex.zh: 湯姆試著用滅火器把火撲滅。

ex.en: There is a fire extinguisher next to the elevator.
ex.zh: 電梯旁邊有一支滅火器。

extinguisher.en: a metal container with a substance inside that is used to stop a fire

ex.en: The explorers discovered a skeleton in the cave.
ex.zh: 探險家們在洞穴裡發現了一具骸骨。

ex.en: Early explorers used the stars for navigation.
ex.zh: 早期的探險家靠星星來導航。

explorer.en: a person who travels to unknown places to learn about them

ex.zh: （口語）前任、前男友／前女友、前配偶

ex.en: Po-lin ran into his ex at the night market yesterday. It was super awkward.
ex.zh: 柏霖昨天在夜市巧遇前女友，超級尷尬。

ex.en: She's still friends with her ex.
ex.zh: 她跟前任還是朋友。

ex.en: a person who used to be your partner or husband or wife
We must execute his orders.
ex.zh: 我們必須執行他的命令。

ex.en: The plan was executed.
ex.zh: 計畫已經執行了。

ex.en: The team executed the marketing plan perfectly.
ex.zh: 團隊完美地執行了行銷計畫。

execute.en: to carry out a plan, order or piece of work

ex.en: The prisoner was executed in 1950.
ex.zh: 那名囚犯在 1950 年被處決。

ex.en: In some countries, criminals are still executed.
ex.zh: 在某些國家，罪犯仍會被處死。

execute.en: to kill someone as an official punishment

ex.en: The capitalists tend to exploit the working people.
ex.zh: 資本家往往會剝削勞工。

ex.en: Some employers exploit young workers.
ex.zh: 有些雇主會剝削年輕員工。

exploit.en: to use someone unfairly for your own gain

exploit.zh: 開發、充分利用（資源、機會）

ex.en: We should exploit this opportunity while we can.
ex.zh: 我們應該趁現在好好把握這個機會。

ex.en: The country plans to exploit its natural resources.
ex.zh: 這個國家計劃開發天然資源。

exploit.en: to make good use of something to get a benefit

ex.en: The melody's execution was flawless.
ex.zh: 這段旋律的演奏完美無瑕。

ex.en: The idea is good, but the execution was poor.
ex.zh: 點子不錯，但執行得很差。

ex.en: The execution of the plan will start next week.
ex.zh: 計畫將於下週開始執行。

execution.en: the act of carrying out a plan, order or piece of work

ex.en: A stay of execution was ordered at the eleventh hour.
ex.zh: 在最後一刻下令暫緩執行死刑。

ex.en: The execution was delayed by the court.
ex.zh: 法院延後了死刑的執行。

execution.en: the act of killing someone as an official punishment

ex.en: Nothing is exempt from Murphy's Law.
ex.zh: 沒有什麼能逃過墨菲定律。

ex.en: Food is exempt from sales tax here.
ex.zh: 這裡的食品免徵營業稅。

ex.en: Students are exempt from the entrance fee.
ex.zh: 學生免收入場費。

exempt.en: not required to follow a rule or pay something

ex.en: Small companies are exempted from the new rule.
ex.zh: 小公司不適用這項新規定。

ex.en: His injury exempted him from military service.
ex.zh: 他因受傷免服兵役。

exempt.en: to say officially that someone does not have to follow a rule or pay

ex.en: Taiwan is a major exporter of semiconductors.
ex.zh: 台灣是半導體的主要出口國。

ex.en: The exporter is responsible for arranging shipping.
ex.zh: 由出口商負責安排運送。

exporter.en: a person, company or country that sells goods to other countries

ex.en: The instructions were very explicit.
ex.zh: 說明寫得很清楚。

ex.en: He gave me explicit instructions not to call.
ex.zh: 他明確交代我不要打電話。

explicit.en: clear and exact, with nothing left unsaid

ex.en: The film contains explicit content.
ex.zh: 這部電影含有露骨內容。

ex.en: This song has explicit lyrics.
ex.zh: 這首歌的歌詞很露骨。

explicit.en: showing sex or violence in a very clear and direct way

ex.en: The writer lived in exile for twenty years.
ex.zh: 這位作家流亡海外二十年。

ex.en: He returned home after years of exile.
ex.zh: 他在流亡多年後回到家鄉。

exile.en: a situation in which you must live away from your own country

ex.en: The king was exiled to a small island.
ex.zh: 國王被流放到一座小島。

ex.en: They were exiled from their own country.
ex.zh: 他們被逐出自己的國家。

exile.en: to force someone to leave their country as a punishment

ex.en: While video platforms do not explicitly ban such content, works of this type will have their traffic restricted.
ex.zh: 雖然影片平台沒有明確禁止這類內容，但這類作品的流量會受到限制。

ex.en: The contract explicitly states that the deposit is non-refundable.
ex.zh: 合約明確規定訂金不予退還。

ex.en: My manager explicitly told me not to share the file.
ex.zh: 我的主管明確告訴我不要分享這個檔案。

explicitly.en: in a clear and exact way that leaves nothing unsaid

ex.en: Space exploration costs billions of dollars.
ex.zh: 太空探索要花費數十億美元。

ex.en: The tour includes a free afternoon for exploration.
ex.zh: 行程包含一個自由探索的下午。

ex.en: Oil exploration in the area began in the 1970s.
ex.zh: 這個地區的石油探勘始於 1970 年代。

exploration.en: the act of travelling to or searching a place to find out about it

exclusion.zh: 排除、除外；（保險）除外條款

ex.en: The exclusion of women from the club was criticized.
ex.zh: 這個俱樂部排除女性的做法受到批評。

ex.en: Read the list of exclusions in your insurance policy.
ex.zh: 請詳閱保單中的除外條款。

exclusion.en: the act of not allowing someone or something to be included

ex.en: It seems to me that she has a tendency to exaggerate.
ex.zh: 在我看來，她說話有誇大的傾向。

ex.en: Tom is exaggerating.
ex.zh: 湯姆在誇大其詞。

ex.en: Don't exaggerate now.
ex.zh: 你可別誇張了。

exaggerate.en: to make something seem bigger, better or worse than it is

ex.en: The explosion may have been caused by a gas leak.
ex.zh: 這場爆炸可能是瓦斯外洩引起的。

ex.en: What was the cause of the explosion?
ex.zh: 爆炸的原因是什麼？

ex.en: Yesterday, an explosion occurred at the fireworks factory.
ex.zh: 昨天，煙火工廠發生了爆炸。

explosion.en: a sudden loud burst caused by something blowing up

ex.en: There has been an explosion in online shopping.
ex.zh: 網路購物出現爆炸性成長。

ex.en: The city has seen a population explosion.
ex.zh: 這座城市的人口激增。

explosion.en: a sudden and very large increase in something

ex.en: Extremists on both sides refused to compromise.
ex.zh: 雙方的極端分子都拒絕妥協。

ex.en: He was called an extremist because of his views.
ex.zh: 他因為自己的觀點而被稱為極端分子。

extremist.en: a person with very strong political or religious beliefs who may use force

ex.en: Pollution is a classic example of a negative externality.
ex.zh: 污染是負外部性的典型例子。

ex.en: Economists call this kind of effect an externality.
ex.zh: 經濟學家把這種效應稱為外部性。

externality.en: a cost or benefit of an activity that affects people who did not choose it

ex.en: Are those explosives?
ex.zh: 那些是爆炸物嗎？

ex.en: Explosives are not allowed on the plane.
ex.zh: 飛機上禁止攜帶爆裂物。

explosive.en: a substance that can blow up and cause damage

explosive.zh: 易爆炸的；爆炸性的（成長）

ex.en: This gas is highly explosive.
ex.zh: 這種氣體極易爆炸。

ex.en: The company has seen explosive growth this year.
ex.zh: 公司今年呈現爆炸性成長。

explosive.en: able to blow up easily, or growing very fast

ex.en: When the bomb exploded, I happened to be there.
ex.zh: 炸彈爆炸時，我剛好在現場。

ex.en: Once the chemical plant caught fire, it exploded.
ex.zh: 化學工廠一起火就爆炸了。

ex.en: A spark caused the gunpowder to explode.
ex.zh: 一點火花讓火藥爆炸了。

explode.en: to burst loudly and violently, causing damage

ex.en: The number of online shoppers has exploded.
ex.zh: 網購人數暴增。

ex.en: Demand for the product exploded last year.
ex.zh: 去年這項產品的需求激增。

explode.en: to increase very quickly and suddenly

ex.en: I feel like my head is going to explode.
ex.zh: 我覺得我的頭快要炸了。

ex.en: She exploded when she heard the news.
ex.zh: 她聽到這個消息時氣炸了。

explode.en: to suddenly show strong feelings, especially anger

ex.en: Parents often exert pressure on their children.
ex.zh: 父母常常給孩子施加壓力。

ex.en: The company exerts a strong influence on the market.
ex.zh: 這家公司對市場有很大的影響力。

exert.en: to use power or influence to affect someone or something

ex.en: Don't exert yourself too much after surgery.
ex.zh: 手術後不要太用力。

ex.en: He exerted himself to finish the work on time.
ex.zh: 他盡全力準時完成工作。

exert.en: to make a great physical or mental effort

expectancy.zh: 預期（常見 life expectancy 平均壽命）

ex.en: Life expectancy in Taiwan is over 80 years.
ex.zh: 台灣人的平均壽命超過 80 歲。

ex.en: Life expectancy has increased thanks to modern medicine.
ex.zh: 多虧現代醫學，平均壽命增加了。

expectancy.en: the amount of time that you are expected to live or last

ex.en: There was an air of expectancy in the room.
ex.zh: 房間裡瀰漫著期待的氣氛。

ex.en: The children waited with eager expectancy.
ex.zh: 孩子們滿心期待地等著。

expectancy.en: a feeling that something exciting is about to happen

ex.en: The examples in this dictionary are easy to understand.
ex.zh: 這本字典的例句很淺顯易懂。

ex.en: He gave several examples of how we could change things.
ex.zh: 他舉了幾個例子，說明我們可以怎麼改變現狀。

example.en: something that shows what a group of things is like

ex.en: Her diligence is a good example to us all.
ex.zh: 她的勤奮是我們所有人的好榜樣。

ex.en: You should give a good example to your children.
ex.zh: 你應該為孩子樹立好榜樣。

example.en: a person or action that others should copy

ex.en: For example, you can pay online.
ex.zh: 例如，你可以線上付款。

ex.en: Many fruits, for example apples, are rich in fiber.
ex.zh: 很多水果，例如蘋果，都富含纖維。

example.en: used to introduce something that shows what you mean

ex.en: The assignment took me longer than I had expected.
ex.zh: 這份作業花的時間比我預期的長。

ex.en: I don't expect that they will support my view.
ex.zh: 我不期望他們會支持我的看法。

ex.en: We expect sales to rise next quarter.
ex.zh: 我們預期下一季銷售會成長。

expect.en: to think that something will happen

ex.en: You can't expect me to always think of everything!
ex.zh: 你不能指望我每件事都想得到！

ex.en: I believe that Tom expects too much from us.
ex.zh: 我覺得湯姆對我們期望太高了。

expect.en: to want or demand that someone does something

ex.en: I'm expecting an important call.
ex.zh: 我在等一通重要的電話。

ex.en: We are expecting guests this evening.
ex.zh: 我們今晚有客人要來。

expect.en: to wait for someone or something that will arrive soon

ex.en: I wonder if life exists on other planets.
ex.zh: 不知道其他星球上有沒有生命存在。

ex.en: I was nine years old when I asked my mom if Santa Claus really existed.
ex.zh: 我九歲時問媽媽聖誕老人是不是真的存在。

ex.en: Facts do not cease to exist because they are ignored.
ex.zh: 事實不會因為被忽略就不存在。

exist.en: to be real or to be present in the world

ex.en: Our plane took off exactly on time at six.
ex.zh: 我們的飛機六點整準時起飛。

ex.en: We made an agreement to meet exactly at ten.
ex.zh: 我們約好十點整見面。

exactly.en: just at the right time or amount, not more or less

ex.en: Tom knows exactly how I like my hair done.
ex.zh: 湯姆很清楚我喜歡什麼樣的髮型。

ex.en: What exactly are Tom and Mary planning to do?
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗究竟打算做什麼？

exactly.en: in a way that is correct in every detail

ex.en: This is exactly what I want to talk about.
ex.zh: 這正是我想談的。

ex.en: "So we should wait?" "Exactly."
ex.zh: 「所以我們應該等嗎？」「沒錯。」

exactly.en: used to say that something is just right or that you agree completely

ex.en: Tom was at a loss how to express himself.
ex.zh: 湯姆不知道該如何表達自己。

ex.en: I don't know how to express my thanks.
ex.zh: 我不知道該如何表達我的謝意。

ex.en: The residents expressed their dissatisfaction at the noise.
ex.zh: 居民們對噪音表示不滿。

express.en: to show what you think or feel with words or actions

ex.en: I took the express train to Kaohsiung.
ex.zh: 我搭快車去高雄。

ex.en: Please send it by express mail.
ex.zh: 請用快遞寄送。

express.en: very fast, or sent by a fast service

ex.en: Everybody except Tom knew he didn't need to do that.
ex.zh: 除了湯姆以外，大家都知道他不需要那麼做。

ex.en: Except for carrots, there is nothing he won't eat.
ex.zh: 除了紅蘿蔔，他什麼都吃。

ex.en: Your composition was good except for the spelling.
ex.zh: 你的作文寫得很好，只是拼字有問題。

except.en: not including a certain person or thing

ex.en: I take a walk every day except when it rains.
ex.zh: 除了下雨天，我每天都散步。

ex.en: I'd love to go, except I have to work.
ex.zh: 我很想去，只是我得工作。

except.en: used to introduce the one case when something is not true

ex.en: The workers complained when their working hours were extended.
ex.zh: 工作時間被延長時，工人們紛紛抱怨。

ex.en: She extended her stay by five days.
ex.zh: 她把停留時間延長了五天。

ex.en: Can we extend the deadline by one week?
ex.zh: 我們可以把截止日期延後一週嗎？

ex.en: Our branches extend all over the country.
ex.zh: 我們的分店遍布全國。

ex.en: His influence extends all over the country.
ex.zh: 他的影響力遍及全國。

ex.en: The Alps extend across eight European countries.
ex.zh: 阿爾卑斯山橫跨歐洲八個國家。

extend.en: to reach or cover a certain distance or area

ex.en: Tom wanted to check the applicant's character reference before extending an offer.
ex.zh: 湯姆想在發出錄取通知前，先查核應徵者的品德推薦。

ex.en: We'd like to extend an invitation to you.
ex.zh: 我們想向您發出邀請。

ex.en: I always need an extra blanket in the wintertime.
ex.zh: 冬天我總是需要多一條毯子。

ex.en: My wife's part-time job brings in a little extra money.
ex.zh: 我太太的兼職工作帶來一些額外收入。

ex.en: It's really cold today, wear some extra clothing.
ex.zh: 今天真的很冷，多穿一點衣服。

extra.en: more than what is usual or already there

ex.en: You need to pay extra for the batteries.
ex.zh: 電池要另外付費。

ex.en: We won't get paid extra for doing this.
ex.zh: 我們做這件事不會拿到額外的報酬。

ex.en: Breakfast costs extra at this hotel.
ex.zh: 這家飯店的早餐要另外付費。

extra.en: in addition to the usual amount or price

extra.zh: 額外的東西、另外收費的項目

ex.en: The car comes with several useful extras.
ex.zh: 這輛車附有好幾項實用的加裝配備。

ex.en: Room service is an extra and is not included.
ex.zh: 客房服務是另外收費的，不包含在內。

extra.en: something added that costs more money

excite.zh: 使興奮、使激動（常用 excited / exciting）

ex.en: As he talked, he got more and more excited.
ex.zh: 他越說越興奮。

ex.en: I was so excited that I couldn't fall asleep.
ex.zh: 我興奮得睡不著。

ex.en: What's the most exciting thing you've done this year?
ex.zh: 你今年做過最刺激的事是什麼？

excite.en: to make someone feel happy, interested and full of energy

ex.en: Your success excites my envy.
ex.zh: 你的成功引起我的嫉妒。

ex.en: The news excited a lot of interest among investors.
ex.zh: 這個消息引起投資人很大的興趣。

excite.en: to make a feeling or interest begin in someone

ex.en: The aviation expert analyzed the statistics in detail.
ex.zh: 航空專家詳細分析了統計資料。

ex.en: A panel of experts discussed the plan.
ex.zh: 一組專家討論了這個計畫。

ex.en: He is an expert in the area of city planning.
ex.zh: 他是都市計畫領域的專家。

expert.en: a person with a lot of skill or knowledge in a subject

ex.en: We need some expert advice on this issue.
ex.zh: 這個問題我們需要專業建議。

ex.en: She is an expert driver.
ex.zh: 她是駕駛高手。

expert.en: having or showing a lot of skill or knowledge

ex.en: The service is excellent in this hotel.
ex.zh: 這家飯店的服務非常好。

ex.en: The car rental agency provided excellent customer service.
ex.zh: 這家租車公司提供了優質的客戶服務。

ex.en: Tom is an excellent cook, isn't he?
ex.zh: 湯姆廚藝很好，對吧？

extent.zh: to some extent：在某種程度上

ex.en: I agree with what you say to some extent.
ex.zh: 某種程度上，我同意你說的話。

ex.en: I agree with you to some extent.
ex.zh: 我某種程度上同意你。

ex.en: I can understand you to some extent.
ex.zh: 某種程度上我能理解你。

extent.en: used to say that something is partly true

ex.en: To what extent can he be trusted?
ex.zh: 他可以信任到什麼程度？

ex.en: We could see the full extent of the park from the hotel.
ex.zh: 我們從飯店可以看到整座公園。

ex.en: We don't know the full extent of the damage yet.
ex.zh: 我們還不知道損害的全部範圍。

extent.en: how large, great or serious something is

ex.en: When we learn languages, we learn fixed expressions.
ex.zh: 學語言時，我們會學到很多固定說法。

ex.en: That expression is archaic.
ex.zh: 那種說法已經過時了。

expression.en: a word or group of words with a particular meaning

ex.en: He saw my expression change.
ex.zh: 他看到我的表情變了。

ex.en: Her expression changed when she heard the news.
ex.zh: 她聽到消息時，表情變了。

expression.en: the look on someone's face that shows how they feel

ex.en: Freedom of expression is a basic right.
ex.zh: 言論自由是基本權利。

ex.en: Please accept this gift as an expression of our thanks.
ex.zh: 請收下這份禮物，聊表我們的謝意。

expression.en: the act of showing what you think or feel

ex.en: Tom was extremely shy when he was a kid.
ex.zh: 湯姆小時候非常害羞。

ex.en: Computers are capable of doing extremely complicated work.
ex.zh: 電腦能處理極為複雜的工作。

ex.en: It's not even a little bit cheap, it's extremely expensive!
ex.zh: 一點也不便宜，貴得要命！

ex.en: That market has been rapidly expanding.
ex.zh: 那個市場一直在快速擴大。

ex.en: The imports from Asian countries have expanded recently.
ex.zh: 最近來自亞洲國家的進口量不斷增加。

ex.en: The company plans to expand into Southeast Asia.
ex.zh: 公司計畫拓展到東南亞市場。

expand.en: to become bigger or to make something bigger

ex.en: Metal expands when it is heated.
ex.zh: 金屬受熱會膨脹。

ex.en: Water expands as it freezes.
ex.zh: 水結冰時會膨脹。

expand.en: to become larger in size or volume

ex.en: Could you expand on that point?
ex.zh: 你可以再詳細說明那一點嗎？

ex.en: The speaker expanded on his main idea.
ex.zh: 講者進一步闡述了他的主要觀點。

expand.en: to give more details about something you said

explore.zh: 探索、探險；到處走走看看

ex.en: I want to explore the world. It’s my dream.
ex.zh: 我想去探索世界，那是我的夢想。

ex.en: Gustavo spends Saturdays exploring local markets.
ex.zh: 古斯塔沃每週六都會去逛當地市場。

ex.en: We are exploring Mars.
ex.zh: 我們正在探索火星。

explore.en: to travel around a place to find out what it is like

ex.en: They explored every avenue in an attempt to avoid war.
ex.zh: 他們想盡一切辦法避免戰爭。

ex.en: We are exploring new ways to cut costs.
ex.zh: 我們正在研究降低成本的新方法。

explore.en: to think about or study something carefully to learn more

ex.en: I think Tom's expectations of us are too high.
ex.zh: 我覺得湯姆對我們的期望太高了。

ex.en: She lived up to our expectations.
ex.zh: 她沒有辜負我們的期望。

ex.en: The result is opposite to our expectations.
ex.zh: 結果和我們的預期相反。

expectation.en: a belief that something will or should happen

ex.en: The explanation Tom gave us was easy to understand.
ex.zh: 湯姆給我們的解釋很好懂。

ex.en: I don't think you need to give an explanation.
ex.zh: 我覺得你不需要解釋。

ex.en: The explanation is by no means satisfactory.
ex.zh: 這個解釋一點也不令人滿意。

explanation.en: words that make something clear or give the reason for it

ex.en: Skin shouldn't be exposed to sunlight for too long.
ex.zh: 皮膚不該長時間暴露在陽光下。

ex.en: He deliberately exposed her to danger.
ex.zh: 他故意讓她陷入危險。

expose.en: to leave someone or something uncovered and unprotected

ex.en: Living abroad exposed me to new ideas.
ex.zh: 住在國外讓我接觸到新的想法。

ex.en: Children should be exposed to different cultures.
ex.zh: 孩子應該接觸不同的文化。

expose.en: to let someone meet or learn about new things

ex.en: The reporter exposed the company's illegal activities.
ex.zh: 記者揭發了這家公司的違法行為。

ex.en: The scandal was exposed by a former employee.
ex.zh: 這起醜聞是被一名前員工揭露的。

expose.en: to show the truth about something bad that was secret

ex.en: Do you believe in the existence of ghosts?
ex.zh: 你相信有鬼存在嗎？

ex.en: What's the point of existence?
ex.zh: 存在的意義是什麼？

existence.en: the state of being real or being alive

ex.en: A new law has come into existence.
ex.zh: 一項新的法律誕生了。

ex.en: The company came into existence in 1998.
ex.zh: 這家公司成立於 1998 年。

existence.en: to begin to be or to start to exist

ex.en: He holds an extreme opinion on education.
ex.zh: 他對教育抱持極端的看法。

ex.en: Your proposal is a bit extreme.
ex.zh: 你的提議有點極端。

extreme.en: very far from what most people think is normal or reasonable

ex.en: Drive with extreme care on icy roads.
ex.zh: 在結冰的路上開車要格外小心。

ex.en: The region suffers from extreme heat in summer.
ex.zh: 這個地區夏天酷熱難耐。

extreme.en: very great in degree or strength

extreme.zh: 極端（go to extremes 走極端）

ex.en: Don't go to extremes.
ex.zh: 別走極端。

ex.en: Young people are apt to go to extremes.
ex.zh: 年輕人容易走極端。

extreme.en: the furthest possible point or limit of something

ex.en: It's been hot this month, but today's an exception.
ex.zh: 這個月一直很熱，但今天是例外。

ex.en: There are exceptions to every rule.
ex.zh: 每條規則都有例外。

exception.en: a person or thing that is not included in a general rule

ex.en: Every team, without exception, was defeated.
ex.zh: 每支隊伍無一例外都被打敗了。

ex.en: All staff, without exception, must wear ID badges.
ex.zh: 所有員工一律必須配戴識別證。

exception.en: used to say that something is true for every single one

exception.zh: with the exception of：除了…之外

ex.en: Everyone came, with the exception of Tom.
ex.zh: 除了湯姆以外，大家都來了。

ex.en: The store is open daily, with the exception of holidays.
ex.zh: 這家店除了國定假日以外每天營業。

exception.en: used to show who or what is not included

ex.en: My son is busy studying for the examinations tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我兒子正忙著準備明天的考試。

ex.en: We have two examinations during this term.
ex.zh: 這學期我們有兩次考試。

ex.en: Allan was lucky and passed the tax accountant examination.
ex.zh: 艾倫很幸運地考過了稅務師考試。

examination.en: a formal test of what you know or can do

ex.en: You'll need a medical examination before you start work.
ex.zh: 上班前你需要做健康檢查。

ex.en: The documents are under examination.
ex.zh: 這些文件正在審查中。

examination.en: a careful look at something to find out about it or check it

ex.en: The price excludes tax.
ex.zh: 這個價格不含稅。

ex.en: Breakfast is excluded from the room rate.
ex.zh: 房價不含早餐。

exclude.en: to not count or include something

ex.en: They excluded John from the club.
ex.zh: 他們把約翰趕出了俱樂部。

ex.en: He was excluded from the club for infractions of the rules.
ex.zh: 他因為違反規定被逐出俱樂部。

exclude.en: to not allow someone to take part in something

ex.en: Save it on the external hard drive.
ex.zh: 把它存到外接硬碟裡。

ex.en: We hired an external consultant for the project.
ex.zh: 我們為這個專案聘請了外部顧問。

ex.en: The company is facing strong external pressure.
ex.zh: 公司正面臨強大的外部壓力。

external.en: on the outside, or coming from outside

ex.en: The expansion of the building's west end is being studied.
ex.zh: 大樓西側的擴建計畫正在研議中。

ex.en: The company is planning an expansion into Asia.
ex.zh: 公司正計畫擴展到亞洲市場。

ex.en: The expansion of the airport will take five years.
ex.zh: 機場擴建工程將需要五年。

expansion.en: the process of becoming bigger or making something bigger

ex.en: The iPhone is an extraordinary cell phone.
ex.zh: iPhone 是一支非凡的手機。

ex.en: Tom is an extraordinary man.
ex.zh: 湯姆是個不平凡的人。

ex.en: True art of life is to see the extraordinary amongst the ordinary.
ex.zh: 生活真正的藝術，是在平凡中看見不平凡。

extraordinary.en: very unusual and much greater or better than normal

extensive.zh: 廣泛的、大量的、大規模的

ex.en: She has extensive knowledge of birds, flowers, and plants.
ex.zh: 她對鳥類和花草植物有廣泛的知識。

ex.en: Those selected will have to face extensive medical and psychological tests.
ex.zh: 被選上的人將接受大量的醫學和心理測驗。

ex.en: The hotel suffered extensive damage in the storm.
ex.zh: 飯店在暴風雨中嚴重受損。

extensive.en: covering a large area or including a lot of things

ex.en: Too much exposure to the sun can damage your skin.
ex.zh: 過度曝曬會傷害皮膚。

ex.en: Early exposure to English helps children learn faster.
ex.zh: 從小接觸英文能幫助孩子學得更快。

exposure.en: the state of being in a place or situation without protection

ex.en: The event gave our brand a lot of exposure.
ex.zh: 這場活動為我們的品牌帶來大量曝光。

ex.en: Social media can give small businesses more exposure.
ex.zh: 社群媒體能讓小型企業獲得更多曝光。

exposure.en: attention that someone or something gets from the public or the news

ex.en: I don't know the exact length of this bridge.
ex.zh: 我不知道這座橋確切有多長。

ex.en: I'm not sure of the exact date.
ex.zh: 我不確定確切的日期。

ex.en: Can you explain the exact meaning of this word?
ex.zh: 你能解釋這個詞的確切意思嗎？

ex.en: The population of China has already exceeded 1.3 billion.
ex.zh: 中國人口已經超過十三億。

ex.en: Don't exceed the speed limit.
ex.zh: 不要超速。

ex.en: The car is exceeding the speed limit.
ex.zh: 這輛車超速了。

exceed.en: to be more than a number or an amount

ex.en: Its level of modernisation far exceeded my expectations.
ex.zh: 它的現代化程度遠遠超出我的預期。

ex.en: Sales this year exceeded our expectations.
ex.zh: 今年的銷售超出了我們的預期。

exceed.en: to be better or greater than what was hoped for

ex.en: The load of the truck was in excess of three tons.
ex.zh: 那輛貨車的載貨量超過三噸。

ex.en: Don't eat sugar in excess.
ex.zh: 糖不要吃過量。

excess.en: an amount that is more than is allowed or needed

ex.en: You'll have to pay for excess baggage.
ex.zh: 行李超重要付費。

ex.en: Wipe off the excess oil with a paper towel.
ex.zh: 用紙巾擦掉多餘的油。

excess.en: more than is allowed or needed

ex.en: Oil is extracted from olives.
ex.zh: 橄欖油是從橄欖中萃取出來的。

ex.en: Your tooth must be extracted.
ex.zh: 你的牙必須拔掉。

ex.en: The software can extract data from PDF files.
ex.zh: 這個軟體可以從 PDF 檔案擷取資料。

extract.en: to take something out, often using force or a special method

ex.en: Read the extract from the novel and answer the questions.
ex.zh: 閱讀這段小說摘錄並回答問題。

ex.en: Add a few drops of vanilla extract.
ex.zh: 加幾滴香草精。

extract.en: a short part taken from a longer text, or a substance taken from something

ex.en: Although he was exhausted, he had to keep working.
ex.zh: 雖然他累壞了，還是得繼續工作。

ex.en: I was exhausted after running the race.
ex.zh: 賽跑完後我累壞了。

ex.en: Translating is exhausting.
ex.zh: 翻譯很累人。

exhaust.en: to make someone feel extremely tired

ex.en: We have exhausted our budget for this year.
ex.zh: 我們今年的預算已經用完了。

ex.en: They exhausted every possible option.
ex.zh: 他們試遍了所有可能的辦法。

exhaust.en: to use all of something so that none is left

ex.en: Car exhaust causes serious pollution in towns.
ex.zh: 汽車廢氣在城鎮造成嚴重汙染。

ex.en: The air was polluted by exhaust gas.
ex.zh: 空氣被廢氣汙染了。

exhaust.en: the gas or the pipe that carries waste gas out of an engine

ex.en: She turned over the page with excitement.
ex.zh: 她興奮地翻過書頁。

ex.en: Meg is filled with excitement.
ex.zh: 梅格興奮不已。

ex.en: His body shivered with excitement.
ex.zh: 他興奮得全身發抖。

excitement.en: the feeling of being very happy and full of energy

ex.en: The drug is still in the experimental stage.
ex.zh: 這種藥還在實驗階段。

ex.en: The band is known for its experimental music.
ex.zh: 這個樂團以實驗性音樂聞名。

experimental.en: new and still being tested to see if it works

ex.en: Hey, sir, the function on the blackboard is not exponential, but trigonometric.
ex.zh: 先生，黑板上的函數不是指數函數，而是三角函數。

ex.en: Solve the exponential equation on page 20.
ex.zh: 解出第 20 頁的指數方程式。

exponential.en: (mathematics) involving a number raised to a variable power

ex.en: The company has seen exponential growth this year.
ex.zh: 公司今年呈現爆炸性成長。

ex.en: There has been an exponential increase in online shopping.
ex.zh: 網路購物急遽增加。

exponential.en: becoming faster and faster over time

ex.en: Dinosaurs became extinct a very long time ago.
ex.zh: 恐龍在很久以前滅絕了。

ex.en: This species of butterfly has already gone extinct.
ex.zh: 這種蝴蝶已經絕種了。

extinct.en: no longer existing because all have died

extinct.zh: （產業、職業等）消失的、不復存在的

ex.en: Some traditional trades are almost extinct in the city.
ex.zh: 有些傳統行業在這座城市幾乎已經消失。

ex.en: Many experts say paper invoices will soon be extinct.
ex.zh: 許多專家說紙本發票很快就會消失。

extinct.en: no longer existing or no longer practiced

ex.en: The examiner asked me to read the passage aloud.
ex.zh: 主考官請我把那段文字朗讀出來。

ex.en: A bank examiner will review our accounts next week.
ex.zh: 下週會有銀行稽核員來審查我們的帳目。

examiner.en: a person who gives or marks a test, or checks something carefully

ex.en: We encountered a lot of difficulties on the expedition.
ex.zh: 我們在探險途中遇到了很多困難。

ex.en: They went on an expedition to the Antarctic.
ex.zh: 他們出發去南極探險。

ex.en: The expedition team reached the top of the mountain.
ex.zh: 探險隊登上了山頂。

expedition.en: a long, organized journey to a faraway or dangerous place

ex.en: We went on a shopping expedition downtown.
ex.zh: 我們去市中心大採購。

ex.en: The fishing expedition lasted all day.
ex.zh: 那趟釣魚之旅持續了一整天。

expedition.en: a short trip made for a particular purpose

ex.en: I don't want to hear any more excuses.
ex.zh: 我不想再聽到其他藉口了。

ex.en: He made many excuses for being late.
ex.zh: 他為遲到找了很多藉口。

excuse.en: a reason you give to explain a mistake or avoid blame

ex.en: Excuse me for not having answered your letter sooner.
ex.zh: 這麼晚才回信，真不好意思。

ex.en: Excuse me, is this seat taken?
ex.zh: 不好意思，這個位子有人坐嗎？

excuse.en: to forgive someone for a small mistake

ex.en: May I be excused from tomorrow's class?
ex.zh: 我明天可以不用上課嗎？

ex.en: She was excused from the meeting because she was sick.
ex.zh: 她因為生病獲准不用參加會議。

excuse.en: to give someone permission not to do something

ex.en: I can't afford to buy such an expensive car.
ex.zh: 我買不起這麼貴的車。

ex.en: This dictionary is very expensive, but is worth buying.
ex.zh: 這本字典雖然很貴，但很值得買。

ex.en: That book is thick, but it's not very expensive.
ex.zh: 這本書雖然很厚，但是不貴。

ex.en: I'd like to exchange this shirt I bought yesterday.
ex.zh: 我想換昨天買的這件襯衫。

ex.en: He's at the bank exchanging money.
ex.zh: 他在銀行換錢。

exchange.en: to give something back and get something else, or to change money

ex.en: Both parties exchanged ideas cordially in the discussion.
ex.zh: 雙方在會談中友好地交換了意見。

ex.en: I exchanged stamps with him.
ex.zh: 我和他交換了郵票。

exchange.en: to give something to someone and get something similar from them

ex.en: This company is listed on the Paris stock exchange.
ex.zh: 這家公司在巴黎證券交易所上市。

ex.en: The stock exchange closes at 1:30 p.m.
ex.zh: 證券交易所下午一點半收盤。

exchange.en: a place where people buy and sell shares or goods

ex.en: The doctor used X-rays to examine my stomach.
ex.zh: 醫生用 X 光檢查我的胃。

ex.en: The doctor is examining the foot.
ex.zh: 醫生正在檢查那隻腳。

ex.en: I had my teeth examined at the dentist's.
ex.zh: 我在牙醫那裡檢查了牙齒。

examine.en: to look at a patient's body to check their health

ex.en: He picked up a mirror and examined his tongue.
ex.zh: 他拿起鏡子仔細看自己的舌頭。

ex.en: The police examined the evidence carefully.
ex.zh: 警方仔細檢視了證據。

examine.en: to look at something very carefully

ex.en: My older sister exercises every day to lose weight.
ex.zh: 我姊姊為了減肥每天都運動。

ex.en: I haven't exercised in a long time.
ex.zh: 我已經很久沒運動了。

ex.en: Exercising more is good for your health.
ex.zh: 多運動有益健康。

exercise.en: to do physical activity to stay healthy and strong

ex.en: It is necessary to take some exercise every day.
ex.zh: 每天做點運動是必要的。

ex.en: She twisted her ankle while she was doing exercise.
ex.zh: 她運動時扭傷了腳踝。

exercise.en: physical activity that you do to stay healthy and strong

ex.en: Do the exercises on page 20 for homework.
ex.zh: 回家作業是第 20 頁的練習題。

ex.en: This exercise helps you practice the past tense.
ex.zh: 這個練習能幫你練習過去式。

exercise.en: a piece of work that helps you practice a skill

ex.en: Each examinee must show an ID card at the entrance.
ex.zh: 每位應試者都必須在入口出示身分證件。

ex.en: The examinees had two hours to finish the test.
ex.zh: 應試者有兩個小時完成考試。

examinee.en: a person who is taking a test

ex.en: I must say, his behaviour is exemplary.
ex.zh: 我該說，他的行為是典範。

ex.en: She received an award for her exemplary service.
ex.zh: 她因表現堪稱模範的服務而獲獎。

exemplary.en: so good that others should copy it

ex.en: This time, although I'm more experienced, there's nobody waiting to meet me.
ex.zh: 這次，雖然我的閱歷更多但是沒有人等著接待我。

ex.en: We are looking for an experienced accountant.
ex.zh: 我們正在找一位有經驗的會計師。

ex.en: The experienced manager handled the crisis calmly.
ex.zh: 那位經驗豐富的經理冷靜地處理了危機。

experienced.en: having a lot of knowledge or skill from doing something for a long time

ex.en: Always check the expiration date before you take any medicine.
ex.zh: 吃任何藥之前，一定要先看有效期限。

ex.en: This milk is past its expiration date, so throw it away.
ex.zh: 這瓶牛奶已經過期了，把它丟掉吧。

ex.en: The expiration date of your insurance card is printed on the back.
ex.zh: 你的保險卡有效期限印在背面。

expiration date.en: the last day that something can be safely used

ex.en: She was in excruciating pain after she broke her leg.
ex.zh: 她摔斷腿後痛得要命。

ex.en: The patient complained of an excruciating headache.
ex.zh: 病人說他頭痛得非常劇烈。

ex.en: Poor circulation can make your extremities feel cold.
ex.zh: 血液循環不良會讓你手腳冰冷。

ex.en: The doctor checked for numbness in his upper and lower extremities.
ex.zh: 醫生檢查他的上下肢是否麻木。

extremity.en: the hands and feet or the ends of the body's limbs

ex.en: The village lies at the southern extremity of the island.
ex.zh: 那個村莊位在島嶼的最南端。

ex.en: They helped each other in their extremity.
ex.zh: 他們在困境中互相幫助。

extremity.en: the farthest point or end of something, or a very bad situation

ex.en: It's no exaggeration to say she saved my life.
ex.zh: 說她救了我一命，一點也不誇張。

ex.en: His story was full of exaggerations, so nobody believed him.
ex.zh: 他的故事充滿誇大之詞，所以沒人相信他。

exaggeration.en: a statement that makes something seem bigger or worse than it is

ex.en: "This is what I was looking for!" he exclaimed.
ex.zh: 「這就是我要找的東西！」他大叫。

ex.en: "What a beautiful view!" she exclaimed when we reached the top.
ex.zh: 我們登頂時，她驚呼：「風景好美啊！」

exclaim.en: to say something suddenly and loudly because of a strong feeling

ex.en: His son was expelled from school.
ex.zh: 他的兒子被學校開除了。

ex.en: The school expelled him.
ex.zh: 他被學校開除了。

ex.en: The club expelled two members for breaking the rules.
ex.zh: 社團開除了兩名違反規定的成員。

expel.en: to force someone to leave a school or a place

ex.en: Their main exports are textiles, especially silk and cotton.
ex.zh: 他們主要的出口品是紡織品，尤其是絲和棉。

ex.en: Exports in January were up 20% over the same period of last year.
ex.zh: 一月的出口比去年同期成長了 20%。

ex.en: Imports exceeded exports last year.
ex.zh: 去年進口超過出口。

export.en: a product that is sold to another country

ex.en: Taiwan exports a lot of computer chips.
ex.zh: 台灣出口大量電腦晶片。

ex.en: You can export the data to Excel.
ex.zh: 你可以把資料匯出成 Excel 檔。

export.en: to sell goods to another country, or to send data out of a program

ex.en: Do not touch the exhibits.
ex.zh: 請勿觸碰展品。

ex.en: Don't touch the exhibits.
ex.zh: 不要碰展品。

exhibit.en: an object shown to the public in a museum or show

ex.en: I'm going to exhibit my roses at the flower show.
ex.zh: 我要拿我的玫瑰去花展展出。

ex.en: The museum is exhibiting works by Van Gogh.
ex.zh: 博物館正在展出梵谷的作品。

ex.en: What is the exchange rate today?
ex.zh: 今天的匯率是多少？

ex.en: The exchange rates for foreign currency change daily.
ex.zh: 外幣的匯率每天都在變。

exchange rate.en: the value of one country's money compared to another's

expatriate.zh: 外派人員、旅居海外的人

ex.en: Many expatriates live in this part of the city.
ex.zh: 這一區住了很多外派人員。

ex.en: As an expatriate, she missed home food the most.
ex.zh: 旅居海外的她最想念家鄉的食物。

expatriate.en: a person who lives in a country that is not their own

ex.en: Did you go to the art exhibition?
ex.zh: 你去看那場藝術展覽了嗎？

ex.en: The exhibition has drawn much attention from the public.
ex.zh: 這場展覽引起了大眾的高度關注。

ex.en: The exhibition is now open.
ex.zh: 展覽現在開放了。

exhibition.en: a public show of art or other objects

ex.en: More than 500 exhibitors took part in the fair.
ex.zh: 超過 500 家參展商參加了這次展覽。

ex.en: Exhibitors can set up their booths on Monday.
ex.zh: 參展商星期一可以布置攤位。

exhibitor.en: a person or company that shows its products or works at a public show

ex.en: I have to reduce my expenses this month.
ex.zh: 我這個月要減少開支。

ex.en: I have run out of my traveling expenses.
ex.zh: 我的旅費用完了。

ex.en: One thousand dollars will cover all the expenses for the party.
ex.zh: 一千美元足以支付派對的所有費用。

expense.en: money that you spend on something

expense.zh: at the expense of：以…為代價；由…出錢

ex.en: He did it at the expense of his health.
ex.zh: 他以犧牲自己的健康為代價完成了這項工作。

ex.en: I had a good dinner at his expense.
ex.zh: 他請我吃了一頓豐盛的晚餐。

expense.en: with a bad effect on something, or paid for by someone

ex.en: Human resources scheduled an exit interview for Friday.
ex.zh: 人資安排在星期五進行離職面談。

ex.en: The exit interview covered feedback about the workplace.
ex.zh: 離職面談內容包括對職場的回饋。

exit interview.en: a talk with an employee who is leaving a company

ex.en: The contract grants exclusivity for the first year.
ex.zh: 合約授予第一年的獨家權。

ex.en: The brand values exclusivity in its distribution agreements.
ex.zh: 這個品牌重視經銷協議中的專屬權。

exclusivity.en: the right or state of being the only one allowed to have or use something

ex.en: The government raised the excise duty on imported spirits.
ex.zh: 政府提高了進口烈酒的貨物稅。

ex.en: The excise duty is included in the price consumers pay.
ex.zh: 消費者支付的價格已包含貨物稅。

excise.en: a tax on certain goods made or sold within a country

ex.en: The team proposed an executable plan for the launch.
ex.zh: 團隊為上市提出了一套可執行的計畫。

ex.en: The file is not executable on this operating system.
ex.zh: 這個檔案無法在此作業系統上執行。

executable.en: able to be carried out or run

ex.en: The excavator dug a trench beside the building.
ex.zh: 挖土機在建築物旁挖了一條溝。

ex.en: An excavator moved the soil into waiting trucks.
ex.zh: 挖土機將土方裝進等候的卡車。

excavator.en: a large machine used for digging holes in the ground

ex.en: Excavation began after the utility lines were marked.
ex.zh: 標出管線位置後，開挖工程開始了。

ex.en: The excavation uncovered an old water pipe.
ex.zh: 挖掘作業發現了一條舊水管。

excavation.en: the work of digging a hole or uncovering things from the ground

ex.en: The final performance exhilarated the crowd.
ex.zh: 最後一場演出讓觀眾情緒高漲。

ex.en: Few things exhilarate her more than sailing at sunrise.
ex.zh: 很少有事情比日出時航海更讓她興奮。

exhilarate.en: to make someone feel very happy, excited and full of energy

ex.en: Passengers with excess baggage have to pay an additional charge.
ex.zh: 行李超重的旅客必須支付額外費用。

ex.en: How much is the fee for excess baggage on this flight?
ex.zh: 這個航班的超重行李費是多少？

excess baggage.en: bags that weigh more than the amount allowed on a plane

ex.en: Weigongcun subway station has three exits.
ex.zh: 魏公村地鐵站有三個出口。

ex.en: Where is the emergency exit?
ex.zh: 緊急出口在哪裡？

ex.en: If there's an emergency, you must run out of the house through this exit.
ex.zh: 有緊急情況時，一定要從這個出口逃出屋外。

exit.en: a way out of a building or place

ex.en: Please exit the building by the rear door.
ex.zh: 請從後門離開大樓。

ex.en: Exit the app and open it again.
ex.zh: 先關閉這個 App，再重新打開。

exit.en: to go out of a place

ex.en: A travel agent will arrange an excursion to Andalusia for you.
ex.zh: 旅行社會幫你安排一趟安達盧西亞之旅。

ex.en: We went on a day excursion to the lake.
ex.zh: 我們去湖邊一日遊。

excursion.en: a short trip made for pleasure, often with a group

ex.en: He is doing very well considering he lacks experience.
ex.zh: 考慮到他缺乏經驗，他已經做得非常好了。

ex.en: I don't think that Tom has any teaching experience.
ex.zh: 我認為湯姆一點教學經驗都沒有。

experience.en: knowledge or skill that you get from doing something for a long time

ex.en: Tom encouraged Mary to write about her experiences.
ex.zh: 湯姆鼓勵瑪麗寫下她的經歷。

ex.en: Did you have a lot of happy experiences in your childhood?
ex.zh: 你小時候是不是有很多快樂的經歷呢？

experience.en: something that happens to you, or the feeling it gives you

ex.en: We have experienced many changes over the last decade.
ex.zh: 過去十年我們經歷了很多變化。

ex.en: At last, they experienced the joy of victory.
ex.zh: 最後，他們感受到了勝利的喜悅。

experience.en: to have something happen to you or to feel something

ex.en: My passport has expired.
ex.zh: 我的護照過期了。

ex.en: Your driver's license has expired.
ex.zh: 你的駕駛執照已經過期了。

ex.en: If your visa expires, you must leave China.
ex.zh: 如果簽證過期，你就必須離開中國。

expire.en: to come to an end and no longer be valid

ex.en: The teacher explained the meaning of the word to us.
ex.zh: 老師向我們解釋了這個字的意思。

ex.en: Would you mind explaining this?
ex.zh: 你介意解釋一下嗎？

ex.en: He explained the literal meaning of the sentences.
ex.zh: 他解釋了句子的字面意思。

explain.en: to make something clear by giving details or reasons

ex.en: The government's expenditures are a bit excessive.
ex.zh: 政府的支出有點過多。

ex.en: We need to reduce our expenditure on travel.
ex.zh: 我們需要減少差旅支出。

expenditure.en: the total amount of money that is spent

ex.en: I got acquainted with the chief executive.
ex.zh: 我認識了那位執行長。

ex.en: She is a senior executive at a tech company.
ex.zh: 她是一家科技公司的高階主管。

executive.en: a person in a senior position in a company

ex.en: I trust his executive ability.
ex.zh: 我相信他的執行能力。

ex.en: We'll need a head hunting agency to find the right man for this executive position.
ex.zh: 我們需要獵頭公司幫我們找到適合這個主管職位的人。

executive.en: relating to managing a company or putting decisions into action

ex.en: Can you expedite the shipping? We need the parts by Monday.
ex.zh: 可以加快出貨嗎？我們星期一前需要零件。

ex.en: Paying an extra fee will expedite your visa application.
ex.zh: 多付一筆費用可以加快簽證申請的處理。

expedite.en: to make a process happen faster

ex.en: Grace goes upstairs to the extension telephone.
ex.zh: 葛蕾絲上樓去接分機電話。

ex.en: Please call me at extension 205.
ex.zh: 請撥分機 205 找我。

extension.en: a telephone line inside a building that connects to the main line

ex.en: This extension cord is too short.
ex.zh: 這條延長線太短了。

ex.en: I need an extension cord.
ex.zh: 我需要一條延長線。

ex.en: I asked my professor for an extension on the paper.
ex.zh: 我向教授申請延後交報告。

extension.en: something added to make a thing longer or to make time last longer

ex.en: We can use the existing equipment for now.
ex.zh: 我們目前可以先使用現有的設備。

ex.en: The new rules will replace the existing ones.
ex.zh: 新規定將取代現行的規定。

ex.en: The final game was really exciting.
ex.zh: 決賽真的很刺激。

ex.en: I have some exciting news to share with you.
ex.zh: 我有一個令人興奮的消息要跟你分享。

ex.en: She is planning an exciting trip to Europe.
ex.zh: 她正在計畫一趟令人期待的歐洲之旅。

ex.en: The kids were excited about the school trip.
ex.zh: 孩子們對校外教學感到很興奮。

ex.en: I'm so excited to see you again next week!
ex.zh: 我好期待下週再見到你！

ex.en: We stayed for an extended weekend in Tainan.
ex.zh: 我們在台南待了一個延長的週末。

ex.en: The store offers an extended warranty for two years.
ex.zh: 這家店提供兩年的延長保固。

ex.en: The whole extended family came to dinner.
ex.zh: 整個大家族都來吃晚餐。

ex.en: Everyone got an extended break after the exam.
ex.zh: 考完試後大家都有個較長的休息。

ex.en: The report exposed the exploitation of factory workers.
ex.zh: 這份報告揭露了工廠工人遭受剝削的情況。

ex.en: Child labor is a serious form of exploitation.
ex.zh: 童工是一種嚴重的剝削形式。

ex.en: The exploitation of natural resources must be controlled.
ex.zh: 對自然資源的開採必須受到管制。

ex.en: The island's exploitation for tourism began in the 1980s.
ex.zh: 這座島嶼從八〇年代開始被開發作觀光用途。

ex.en: The expected arrival time is six o'clock.
ex.zh: 預計的抵達時間是六點。

ex.en: The results were better than expected.
ex.zh: 結果比預期的還要好。

expected.zh: 預期、預料（expect 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: We expected the meeting to be short, but it lasted two hours.
ex.zh: 我們以為會議很短，結果開了兩個小時。

ex.en: She expected her friends to arrive early.
ex.zh: 她預期朋友們會早到。

ex.en: The weather this spring has been exceptionally warm.
ex.zh: 今年春天的天氣異常溫暖。

ex.en: She is an exceptionally talented young pianist.
ex.zh: 她是一位才華格外出眾的年輕鋼琴家。

ex.en: The teacher read an excerpt from the novel to the class.
ex.zh: 老師對全班朗讀了小說的一段節選。

ex.en: You can read an excerpt of the book on the website.
ex.zh: 你可以在網站上閱讀這本書的節錄。

ex.en: This excerpt shows the writer's simple style.
ex.zh: 這段摘錄展現了作者簡潔的風格。

ex.en: The magazine will excerpt a chapter from her new book.
ex.zh: 這本雜誌將摘錄她新書中的一章。

ex.en: He excerpted a few lines from the speech for his essay.
ex.zh: 他從演說中摘錄了幾行放進他的文章裡。

ex.en: The scientist has traveled extensively in Asia.
ex.zh: 這位科學家曾在亞洲各地廣泛旅行。

ex.en: This topic has been extensively discussed in the media.
ex.zh: 這個話題在媒體上已被廣泛討論過。

ex.en: She read extensively before writing her report.
ex.zh: 她在寫報告前廣泛閱讀了大量資料。

ex.en: The company is expanding into new markets.
ex.zh: 這家公司正把業務擴展到新市場。

ex.en: The balloon keeps expanding as we blow into it.
ex.zh: 我們一直吹氣，氣球就不斷膨脹。

ex.en: The Chancellor of the Exchequer announced the budget today.
ex.zh: 財政大臣今天公布了預算案。

ex.en: Taxes pay money into the nation's exchequer.
ex.zh: 稅收為國家的國庫挹注資金。

ex.en: Exeter is a city in the southwest of England.
ex.zh: 埃克塞特是英格蘭西南部的一座城市。

ex.en: The train to Exeter leaves from the station at noon.
ex.zh: 往埃克塞特的火車中午從車站出發。

ex.en: The store has an expanded menu this season.
ex.zh: 這家店這一季有擴充過的菜單。

ex.en: Readers can find an expanded version of the story online.
ex.zh: 讀者可以在網路上找到這個故事的擴充版。

expanded.zh: 擴大（expand 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: The company expanded its business to three new cities.
ex.zh: 公司把業務擴展到三個新城市。

ex.en: The balloon expanded as she blew into it.
ex.zh: 她吹氣時，氣球漸漸膨脹起來。

ex.en: The hikers were cold on the exposed mountain ridge.
ex.zh: 健行者在毫無遮蔽的山脊上覺得很冷。

ex.en: Keep exposed wires away from water.
ex.zh: 讓外露的電線遠離水。

ex.en: Workers exposed to loud noise should wear ear protection.
ex.zh: 暴露在大噪音下的工作人員應該戴耳塞。

ex.en: He felt exposed after his private emails were made public.
ex.zh: 私人電子郵件被公開後，他覺得自己毫無隱私。

ex.en: Many sea turtles are in danger of extinction.
ex.zh: 許多海龜面臨絕種的危機。

ex.en: Scientists study the extinction of the dinosaurs millions of years ago.
ex.zh: 科學家研究數百萬年前恐龍的滅絕。

ex.en: She excels at math and always gets top scores.
ex.zh: 她擅長數學，總是拿到最高分。

ex.en: He excelled in sports when he was young.
ex.zh: 他年輕時在體育方面表現出色。

ex.en: Stress can exacerbate many health problems.
ex.zh: 壓力可能使許多健康問題惡化。

ex.en: The heavy rain exacerbated the flooding in the valley.
ex.zh: 大雨使山谷裡的水患更加嚴重。

ex.en: Her honesty exemplifies the values of our school.
ex.zh: 她的誠實是我們學校價值觀的典範。

ex.en: The teacher used a short story to exemplify the idea.
ex.zh: 老師用一個短篇故事來舉例說明這個概念。

ex.en: Workers used explosives to clear rocks from the mountain road.
ex.zh: 工人用炸藥清除山路上的石頭。

ex.en: Airport staff check bags for explosives.
ex.zh: 機場人員會檢查行李中有沒有爆裂物。

ex.en: The soup was extraordinarily good.
ex.zh: 這碗湯好喝得出奇。

ex.en: It was an extraordinarily cold winter this year.
ex.zh: 今年的冬天格外寒冷。

ex.en: She is extraordinarily talented for someone so young.
ex.zh: 就這麼年輕的人來說，她才華驚人。

ex.en: The boy behaved extraordinarily well during the long trip.
ex.zh: 這個男孩在漫長的旅途中表現得出奇地好。

ex.en: I was exhausted after the long flight.
ex.zh: 長途飛行之後我累壞了。

ex.en: The exhausted runners sat down at the finish line.
ex.zh: 筋疲力盡的跑者在終點線坐了下來。

ex.en: Our supply of fresh water was almost exhausted.
ex.zh: 我們的淡水存量幾乎用完了。

ex.en: The exhausted battery would not turn the phone on.
ex.zh: 電池耗盡了，手機開不了機。

ex.en: The dentist recommended the extraction of the damaged tooth.
ex.zh: 牙醫建議拔除那顆受損的牙齒。

ex.en: The extraction of oil from the ground takes special equipment.
ex.zh: 從地底提取石油需要特殊設備。

ex.en: Coffee extraction depends on water temperature and time.
ex.zh: 咖啡的萃取取決於水溫與時間。

ex.en: This oil is made by the cold extraction of olives.
ex.zh: 這種油是用冷萃取橄欖的方式製成的。

expressive.zh: 表情豐富的；善於表達的

ex.en: She has very expressive eyes.
ex.zh: 她的眼睛非常有神，富有表情。

ex.en: The singer's expressive voice moved the whole audience.
ex.zh: 歌手富有感情的嗓音感動了全場觀眾。

ex.en: Dance can be an expressive way to share your feelings.
ex.zh: 舞蹈可以是分享感受的一種表達方式。

ex.en: She wore an exquisite silk dress to the party.
ex.zh: 她穿著一件精緻的絲綢洋裝去參加派對。

ex.en: The chef prepared an exquisite meal for us.
ex.zh: 主廚為我們準備了一頓精緻的料理。

ex.en: She collapsed on the sofa from exhaustion.
ex.zh: 她累得癱倒在沙發上。

ex.en: The runners were nearly at the point of exhaustion.
ex.zh: 跑者們幾乎累到極限。

ex.en: The exhaustion of oil supplies is a worry for the future.
ex.zh: 石油供應耗盡是對未來的一大隱憂。

ex.en: The fund's exhaustion forced the project to stop.
ex.zh: 資金耗盡迫使計畫停擺。

ex.en: A vast expanse of white snow stretched in front of us.
ex.zh: 一大片白雪在我們面前延伸開來。

ex.en: They looked across the expanse of the blue ocean.
ex.zh: 他們眺望著遼闊的藍色海洋。

ex.en: The sign expressly forbids taking photos inside the museum.
ex.zh: 告示明確禁止在博物館內拍照。

ex.en: I came here expressly to see you.
ex.zh: 我是特地來見你的。

ex.en: They threw an extravagant wedding with five hundred guests.
ex.zh: 他們辦了一場有五百位賓客的奢華婚禮。

ex.en: It seems extravagant to buy a new phone every year.
ex.zh: 每年都買新手機似乎太浪費了。

ex.en: His extravagant spending left him with no savings.
ex.zh: 他揮霍無度的花費讓他一點存款都沒有。

ex.en: The exterior of the house needs a fresh coat of paint.
ex.zh: 這棟房子的外牆需要重新粉刷。

ex.en: Behind his calm exterior, he was very nervous.
ex.zh: 在他平靜的外表下，其實非常緊張。

ex.en: The exterior walls are made of brick.
ex.zh: 外牆是用磚頭砌成的。

ex.en: Check the exterior door to make sure it is locked.
ex.zh: 請檢查一下外門有沒有鎖好。

ex.en: Scientific progress depends on careful experimentation.
ex.zh: 科學進步仰賴仔細的實驗。

ex.en: Cooking is a lot about experimentation and tasting.
ex.zh: 烹飪很大程度上就是不斷嘗試與品嚐。

ex.en: From the hill we saw an expansive view of the valley.
ex.zh: 我們從山丘上看到一片遼闊的山谷景色。

ex.en: The hotel has expansive gardens full of flowers.
ex.zh: 這間飯店有種滿花的寬廣庭園。

ex.en: After dinner he became expansive and told stories for hours.
ex.zh: 晚餐後他變得健談，講了好幾個小時的故事。

ex.en: The company took an expansive approach and opened ten new stores.
ex.zh: 公司採取擴張策略，開了十間新店。

ex.en: His exaggerated story about the fish made everyone laugh.
ex.zh: 他把那條魚講得誇張無比，讓大家都笑了。

ex.en: The report gave an exaggerated picture of the danger.
ex.zh: 這份報告把危險描述得言過其實。

ex.en: She spoke with an exaggerated accent to amuse the kids.
ex.zh: 她用誇張的口音說話逗孩子們開心。

ex.en: The exam was exceedingly difficult for most students.
ex.zh: 這場考試對大多數學生來說極其困難。

ex.en: She is an exceedingly kind and patient teacher.
ex.zh: 她是一位非常親切又有耐心的老師。

ex.en: He worries excessively about small things.
ex.zh: 他對小事過度擔心。

ex.en: The room was excessively hot, so we opened the windows.
ex.zh: 房間熱得過頭，所以我們打開了窗戶。

ex.en: The trip costs five hundred dollars, excluding meals.
ex.zh: 這趟旅行費用是五百美元，餐費不包括在內。

ex.en: Excluding weekends, the shop is open every day.
ex.zh: 除了週末之外，這家店每天都有營業。

ex.en: There was a mass exodus from the city before the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨來臨前，大批人潮湧出城市。

ex.en: The factory closure caused an exodus of young workers.
ex.zh: 工廠關閉導致年輕工人大量外流。

ex.en: Workers will excavate the ground before building the tunnel.
ex.zh: 工人在建造隧道之前會先挖開地面。

ex.en: Archaeologists excavated an ancient village near the river.
ex.zh: 考古學家在河邊挖掘出一座古老的村落。

ex.en: The student faced expulsion for cheating on the exam.
ex.zh: 那名學生因為考試作弊面臨被開除。

ex.en: The expulsion of the diplomat caused a dispute between the two countries.
ex.zh: 這名外交官被驅逐，引發了兩國之間的爭議。

ex.en: She is a leading exponent of modern dance.
ex.zh: 她是現代舞的代表人物之一。

ex.en: The professor was an early exponent of this theory.
ex.zh: 這位教授是這項理論的早期倡導者。

ex.en: In 2 to the power of 5, the number 5 is the exponent.
ex.zh: 在 2 的 5 次方中，數字 5 就是指數。

ex.en: The students learned how to calculate an exponent on their calculators.
ex.zh: 學生們學會如何用計算機算出指數。

ex.en: The book gives a clear exposition of the theory.
ex.zh: 這本書對該理論做了清楚的闡述。

ex.en: Her exposition of the plan made it easy to follow.
ex.zh: 她對計畫的說明讓人很容易理解。

ex.en: The city will host an international exposition next summer.
ex.zh: 這座城市明年夏天將舉辦國際博覽會。

ex.en: We visited the technology exposition and tried new devices.
ex.zh: 我們參觀了科技博覽會，試用了一些新裝置。

ex.en: The doctor ordered an exploratory test to find the cause.
ex.zh: 醫生安排了一項探查性檢查來找出原因。

ex.en: We held an exploratory meeting before starting the project.
ex.zh: 在啟動計畫前，我們先開了一場初步探討的會議。

ex.en: Don't expend all your energy in the first hour.
ex.zh: 別在第一個小時就把體力用光。

ex.en: The company expended a lot of money on advertising.
ex.zh: 公司在廣告上花了很多錢。

ex.en: The excitation of the nerve cell produces a tiny electrical signal.
ex.zh: 神經細胞受到刺激會產生微小的電訊號。

ex.en: The audience's excitation grew as the concert began.
ex.zh: 演唱會一開始，觀眾的興奮情緒就愈來愈高。

ex.en: Firefighters worked to extinguish the flames.
ex.zh: 消防員努力撲滅火焰。

ex.en: Please extinguish your cigarette before entering the building.
ex.zh: 進入大樓前請先熄掉你的香菸。

ex.en: The police made an exhaustive search of the house.
ex.zh: 警方對這棟房子進行了徹底的搜查。

ex.en: The book offers an exhaustive list of local plants.
ex.zh: 這本書列出了詳盡的當地植物清單。

expressed.zh: 表達（express 的過去式、過去分詞）

ex.en: She expressed her thanks with a short note.
ex.zh: 她用一張短短的便條表達謝意。

ex.en: He expressed doubts about the new plan.
ex.zh: 他對新計畫表示懷疑。

ex.en: Riding the roller coaster was an exhilarating experience.
ex.zh: 坐雲霄飛車是一次令人興奮的體驗。

ex.en: It is exhilarating to reach the top of a mountain.
ex.zh: 登上山頂令人振奮。

ex.en: Breathe in slowly, then exhale through your mouth.
ex.zh: 慢慢吸氣，然後用嘴巴吐氣。

ex.en: He exhaled a long cloud of smoke into the cold air.
ex.zh: 他往冷空氣中吐出一大團煙霧。

existential.zh: 關於存在的；存在主義的

ex.en: He went through an existential crisis after turning forty.
ex.zh: 他四十歲後經歷了一場存在危機。

ex.en: The philosopher wrote about existential questions of life and death.
ex.zh: 這位哲學家寫了關於生死的存在問題。

ex.en: Scientists say climate change is an existential threat.
ex.zh: 科學家說氣候變遷是攸關存亡的威脅。

ex.en: The company faced an existential challenge when sales collapsed.
ex.zh: 銷售崩跌時，公司面臨攸關存亡的挑戰。

ex.en: The medicine should be used externally, not swallowed.
ex.zh: 這種藥只能外用，不能吞下去。

ex.en: The building looks old externally but is modern inside.
ex.zh: 這棟建築從外表看很老舊，裡面卻很現代。

ex.en: The old cheese exuded a strong smell.
ex.zh: 那塊陳年起司散發出濃烈的氣味。

ex.en: She exudes confidence whenever she speaks in public.
ex.zh: 她在公開場合發言時總散發著自信。

ex.en: Check the expiry date on the milk before you drink it.
ex.zh: 喝牛奶前先看一下保存期限。

ex.en: My passport is nearing its expiry, so I need to renew it.
ex.zh: 我的護照快到期了，所以得去換新的。

ex.en: The contract will end upon expiry in June.
ex.zh: 合約將於六月期滿後終止。

ex.en: The exertion of climbing the hill left him out of breath.
ex.zh: 爬那座山的費力讓他喘不過氣。

ex.en: Doctors told him to avoid physical exertion after the surgery.
ex.zh: 醫生叫他手術後避免劇烈的體力活動。

ex.en: It took great mental exertion to finish the exam.
ex.zh: 要完成這場考試得費很大的腦力。

exuberant.zh: 興高采烈的；精力充沛的

ex.en: The exuberant crowd cheered when the team won.
ex.zh: 球隊獲勝時，興高采烈的群眾歡呼起來。

ex.en: She gave an exuberant greeting to her old friends.
ex.zh: 她熱情洋溢地向老朋友打招呼。

ex.en: The exuberant puppy ran around the garden all morning.
ex.zh: 那隻活力十足的小狗整個早上都在花園裡跑來跑去。

ex.en: She let out an exclamation of surprise when she saw the gift.
ex.zh: 她看到禮物時發出一聲驚呼。

ex.en: "Wow!" is an exclamation we use to show amazement.
ex.zh: 「哇！」是我們用來表達驚訝的感嘆詞。

ex.en: The new method was tested experimentally in the lab.
ex.zh: 這個新方法已在實驗室中做過實驗測試。

ex.en: The restaurant is experimentally offering a vegan menu this month.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳這個月試驗性地推出純素菜單。

ex.en: He threw up his hands in exasperation.
ex.zh: 他氣得雙手一攤。

ex.en: She sighed with exasperation as the printer jammed again.
ex.zh: 印表機又卡紙了，她惱怒地嘆了口氣。

ex.en: The children ran excitedly toward the playground.
ex.zh: 孩子們興奮地跑向遊樂場。

ex.en: She talked excitedly about her upcoming trip.
ex.zh: 她興奮地談著即將到來的旅行。

ex.en: She was named executor of her uncle's will.
ex.zh: 她被指定為叔叔遺囑的執行人。

ex.en: The executor must divide the property among the family.
ex.zh: 遺囑執行人必須把財產分給家人。

ex.en: The experimenter recorded the results after each test.
ex.zh: 實驗者在每次測試後記錄結果。

ex.en: An experimenter must be careful not to influence the outcome.
ex.zh: 實驗者必須小心，避免影響結果。

ex.en: The government is working to prevent extremism among young people.
ex.zh: 政府正努力防止年輕人走向極端主義。

ex.en: Extremism in any form is a threat to peace.
ex.zh: 任何形式的極端主義都是對和平的威脅。

ex.en: She joins many extracurricular activities after school.
ex.zh: 她放學後參加很多課外活動。

ex.en: Extracurricular clubs help students make friends.
ex.zh: 課外社團能幫助學生交朋友。

ex.en: The suspect fought against his extradition to another country.
ex.zh: 嫌犯極力反對被引渡到另一個國家。

ex.en: The two countries signed an extradition treaty last year.
ex.zh: 這兩個國家去年簽署了引渡條約。

ex.en: The kidneys are important for the excretion of waste.
ex.zh: 腎臟對排出廢物很重要。

ex.en: Sweating is another form of excretion.
ex.zh: 流汗是另一種排泄方式。

ex.en: The school offers experiential learning through field trips.
ex.zh: 學校透過校外教學提供體驗式的學習。

ex.en: Travel gives you experiential knowledge that books cannot.
ex.zh: 旅行帶給你書本給不了的親身經驗。

exhausting.zh: 累人的；令人筋疲力盡的

ex.en: It was an exhausting day full of meetings.
ex.zh: 那是充滿會議、令人筋疲力盡的一天。

ex.en: Taking care of three small kids is exhausting.
ex.zh: 照顧三個小孩累死人了。

ex.en: The children shouted with exuberance when the snow began to fall.
ex.zh: 下雪時，孩子們興高采烈地大叫。

ex.en: Her exuberance made everyone at the party smile.
ex.zh: 她的熱情洋溢讓派對上的每個人都笑了。

ex.en: The coach exhorted the players to keep trying.
ex.zh: 教練力勸球員們持續努力。

ex.en: The leaflet exhorts people to save water during the dry season.
ex.zh: 這份傳單呼籲大家在乾旱季節節約用水。

ex.en: Buying a third car seemed like pure extravagance.
ex.zh: 買第三輛車簡直是奢侈浪費。

ex.en: Her only extravagance is a weekly bunch of fresh flowers.
ex.zh: 她唯一的奢侈就是每週買一束鮮花。

ex.en: Our coach is an exacting man who accepts no excuses.
ex.zh: 我們的教練要求嚴格，不接受任何藉口。

ex.en: Making fine watches is exacting work.
ex.zh: 製作精密手錶是一項要求極高的工作。

ex.en: He began to expound his theory to the curious students.
ex.zh: 他開始向好奇的學生詳細說明他的理論。

ex.en: Let me expound on why I changed my mind.
ex.zh: 讓我詳細說明我為什麼改變主意。

ex.en: The man was arrested for extortion.
ex.zh: 那名男子因勒索被逮捕。

ex.en: Shop owners complained of extortion by local gangs.
ex.zh: 店家抱怨遭到當地幫派敲詐。

ex.en: Despite her teacher's exhortation, he did not study harder.
ex.zh: 儘管老師一再勸告，他還是沒有更用功。

ex.en: The coach's final exhortation lifted the team's spirits.
ex.zh: 教練最後的勉勵振奮了球隊的士氣。

ex.en: Reviewers extolled the film's beautiful photography.
ex.zh: 影評人大力稱讚這部電影優美的攝影。

ex.en: He extolled the virtues of a healthy diet.
ex.zh: 他大力宣揚健康飲食的好處。

ex.en: The cake was exquisitely decorated with tiny sugar flowers.
ex.zh: 那個蛋糕以小小的糖花精緻地裝飾著。

ex.en: She sang exquisitely, and the whole room fell silent.
ex.zh: 她唱得極其動人，全場鴉雀無聲。

ex.en: Only a few copies of the old book are still extant.
ex.zh: 這本古書只剩幾本現存的版本。

ex.en: Scientists compared extant species with fossils.
ex.zh: 科學家把現存的物種和化石做比較。

ex.en: His constant excuses exasperate me.
ex.zh: 他不斷找藉口，讓我很火大。

ex.en: Don't exasperate your teacher by being late again.
ex.zh: 別再遲到去惹惱老師了。

ex.en: It was expedient to leave early to avoid traffic.
ex.zh: 為了避開車潮，提早出發是方便可行的做法。

ex.en: The manager chose the most expedient solution.
ex.zh: 經理選了最省事可行的解決辦法。

ex.en: Borrowing money was only a temporary expedient.
ex.zh: 借錢只是一時的權宜之計。

ex.en: They used a plastic bag as an expedient to keep the rain out.
ex.zh: 他們拿塑膠袋當權宜之計來擋雨。

extravaganza.zh: 盛大華麗的表演或活動

ex.en: The holiday show was a musical extravaganza with fireworks.
ex.zh: 這場節慶表演是一場有煙火的盛大音樂秀。

ex.en: The school put on a talent extravaganza for the whole town.
ex.zh: 學校為全鎮辦了一場盛大的才藝秀。

ex.en: New evidence helped exonerate the man who had been accused.
ex.zh: 新證據幫那名被指控的男子洗清了罪嫌。

ex.en: The investigation exonerated the pilot of any blame for the accident.
ex.zh: 調查證明機師對這起事故無需負責。

ex.en: The exiled leader lived abroad for many years.
ex.zh: 那位流亡的領袖在國外住了很多年。

ex.en: Many exiled writers kept writing in their own language.
ex.zh: 許多流亡的作家仍用自己的母語寫作。

ex.en: Firefighters worked to extricate the driver from the car.
ex.zh: 消防員努力把駕駛從車裡救出來。

ex.en: It took him months to extricate himself from the debt.
ex.zh: 他花了好幾個月才擺脫債務。

ex.en: The number of users grew exponentially after the launch.
ex.zh: 產品上市後，使用者人數急遽成長。

ex.en: Bacteria can multiply exponentially in warm conditions.
ex.zh: 在溫暖的環境中，細菌可以呈指數倍增。

ex.en: The chef expertly sliced the fish.
ex.zh: 主廚熟練地把魚切片。

ex.en: She expertly steered the boat through the narrow channel.
ex.zh: 她巧妙地駕船穿過狹窄的水道。

ex.en: Scientists are searching for signs of extraterrestrial life.
ex.zh: 科學家正在尋找外星生命的跡象。

ex.en: The movie is about an extraterrestrial visitor who gets lost on Earth.
ex.zh: 這部電影講的是一位在地球上迷路的外星訪客。

ex.en: In the story, the extraterrestrial makes friends with a young boy.
ex.zh: 故事中，那個外星人和一個小男孩成了朋友。

ex.en: Do you believe an extraterrestrial has ever visited our planet?
ex.zh: 你相信有外星人曾經造訪過我們的星球嗎？

ex.en: She is an exemplar of hard work and honesty.
ex.zh: 她是努力與誠實的典範。

ex.en: The school holds him up as an exemplar for new students.
ex.zh: 學校把他當作新生的榜樣。

ex.en: This building is a fine exemplar of modern design.
ex.zh: 這棟建築是現代設計的絕佳範例。

ex.en: Money is an extrinsic reward, not an inner one.
ex.zh: 金錢是外在的獎勵，而不是內在的。

ex.en: Extrinsic factors such as noise can affect your sleep.
ex.zh: 噪音之類的外在因素會影響睡眠。

ex.en: He muttered an expletive when he dropped the glass.
ex.zh: 他打破杯子時低聲罵了一句髒話。

ex.en: The show was edited to remove every expletive.
ex.zh: 這個節目經過剪輯，刪掉了所有的髒話。

ex.en: An expletive word in a sentence does not add real meaning.
ex.zh: 句子裡的虛詞並不增添實際意義。

ex.en: The editor deleted some expletive phrases from the essay.
ex.zh: 編輯刪掉了文章裡一些多餘的詞語。

ex.en: Exporting countries benefit when the price of goods rises.
ex.zh: 出口國在商品價格上漲時會受益。

ex.en: The exporting company ships tea to many countries.
ex.zh: 這家出口公司把茶葉運往許多國家。

ex.en: She gave an exasperated sigh when the printer jammed again.
ex.zh: 印表機又卡紙時，她氣惱地嘆了口氣。

ex.en: I was so exasperated by his excuses that I stopped listening.
ex.zh: 我被他的藉口惹得很火大，乾脆不聽了。

exasperated.zh: 使惱怒（exasperate 的過去式／過去分詞）

ex.en: The constant delays exasperated everyone on the team.
ex.zh: 不斷的延誤讓全隊的人都很惱火。

ex.en: Her brother's teasing had exasperated her all afternoon.
ex.zh: 哥哥的調侃讓她一整個下午都很惱火。

ex.en: In the story, the executioner waited for the judge's order.
ex.zh: 故事裡，行刑者等待法官的命令。

ex.en: The museum has the old clothing of a medieval executioner.
ex.zh: 博物館展示著一件中世紀行刑者的舊服裝。

ex.en: The hotel charged an exorbitant price for a small room.
ex.zh: 那間旅館為一個小房間收取了離譜的高價。

ex.en: Many students cannot afford the exorbitant cost of textbooks.
ex.zh: 許多學生負擔不起過高的教科書費用。

ex.en: The children waited with expectant faces for the gifts.
ex.zh: 孩子們帶著期待的表情等待禮物。

ex.en: Expectant mothers should get regular check-ups.
ex.zh: 孕婦應該定期做產檢。

ex.en: She felt pure exhilaration as the roller coaster dropped.
ex.zh: 雲霄飛車俯衝時，她感到純粹的興奮。

ex.en: The runners crossed the line with a sense of exhilaration.
ex.zh: 跑者們帶著興奮的心情衝過終點線。

ex.en: The professor holds an exalted position at the university.
ex.zh: 那位教授在大學裡地位崇高。

ex.en: She was not used to mixing with such exalted guests.
ex.zh: 她不習慣與這麼尊貴的賓客交往。

ex.en: The poem exalts the beauty of nature.
ex.zh: 這首詩讚頌大自然的美。

ex.en: The speech exalted the hard work of the volunteers.
ex.zh: 這場演說高度讚揚志工的辛勤付出。

ex.en: Success should not exalt you above your friends.
ex.zh: 成功不該讓你覺得自己高人一等。

ex.en: The article discusses the effects of extramarital relationships on families.
ex.zh: 這篇文章討論婚外關係對家庭的影響。

ex.en: He denied any extramarital involvement.
ex.zh: 他否認有任何婚外情。

ex.en: The club's exclusionary rules kept many people out.
ex.zh: 這個俱樂部排他性的規定把許多人擋在門外。

ex.en: Critics say the policy is exclusionary.
ex.zh: 批評者認為這項政策具有排他性。

ex.en: His face was expressionless when he heard the news.
ex.zh: 他聽到消息時面無表情。

ex.en: She gave an expressionless answer and walked away.
ex.zh: 她面無表情地回答後便走開了。

ex.en: Please remove any extraneous details from your report.
ex.zh: 請把報告裡任何無關的細節刪掉。

ex.en: Turn off the radio so extraneous noise does not distract you.
ex.zh: 把收音機關掉，免得無關的噪音讓你分心。

ex.en: The editor cut every extraneous word from the article.
ex.zh: 編輯把文章裡每一個多餘的字都刪掉了。

ex.en: We hired a company to exterminate the ants in our kitchen.
ex.zh: 我們請了一家公司來消滅廚房裡的螞蟻。

ex.en: The farmers tried to exterminate the pests before harvest.
ex.zh: 農夫們試圖在收成前消滅害蟲。

ex.en: Writing in a journal helps me externalize my feelings.
ex.zh: 寫日記幫助我把感受具體表達出來。

ex.en: Some companies try to externalize their costs onto the public.
ex.zh: 有些公司試圖把成本轉嫁給大眾。

ex.en: The surgeon performed an excision of the small growth.
ex.zh: 外科醫師切除了那個小腫塊。

ex.en: Excision of the damaged tissue helped the wound heal.
ex.zh: 切除受損的組織有助於傷口癒合。

ex.en: The excision of two chapters made the book shorter.
ex.zh: 刪掉兩個章節讓這本書變短了。

ex.en: The editor suggested the excision of the last paragraph.
ex.zh: 編輯建議刪去最後一段。

ex.en: The children looked up expectantly when the teacher opened the box.
ex.zh: 老師打開盒子時，孩子們滿懷期待地抬頭看。

ex.en: She waited expectantly by the phone for his call.
ex.zh: 她守在電話旁期待著他的來電。

ex.en: The manager made workers feel they were expendable.
ex.zh: 那位經理讓員工覺得自己是可以隨時被捨棄的。

ex.en: We carry expendable supplies like bandages and batteries.
ex.zh: 我們攜帶繃帶和電池這類消耗性的物資。

expendable.zh: 消耗品；可犧牲的人或物

ex.en: Paper cups are expendables that we buy every month.
ex.zh: 紙杯是我們每個月都要買的消耗品。

ex.en: The old soldiers were treated as expendables by their leaders.
ex.zh: 那些老兵被長官當成可犧牲的棋子。

ex.en: The extermination of the rats took two weeks.
ex.zh: 老鼠花了兩週才被消滅乾淨。

ex.en: They hired a company for the extermination of ants.
ex.zh: 他們請了一家公司來除蟻。

ex.en: The puppy is very excitable around strangers.
ex.zh: 這隻小狗見到陌生人就非常容易興奮。

ex.en: He is an excitable child who cries and laughs easily.
ex.zh: 他是個情緒容易激動的孩子，很容易哭也很容易笑。

ex.en: She was always expensively dressed.
ex.zh: 她總是穿著昂貴的衣服。

ex.en: The house was expensively decorated with fine furniture.
ex.zh: 這棟房子用高級家具花大錢裝潢過。

ex.en: The workers felt exploited by the company.
ex.zh: 工人們覺得自己被公司剝削了。

ex.en: The scammer exploited the old man's trust.
ex.zh: 詐騙者利用了老先生的信任。

ex.en: The country exploited its natural gas to grow the economy.
ex.zh: 這個國家開發天然氣來發展經濟。

ex.en: She exploited the free tools to build her website.
ex.zh: 她利用免費工具建立了自己的網站。

ex.en: My sister is an extrovert who loves meeting new people.
ex.zh: 我姐姐是個喜歡認識新朋友的外向者。

ex.en: An extrovert often feels energized at a big party.
ex.zh: 外向的人在大型派對上常常覺得精力充沛。

ex.en: An expeditionary team went to study the glacier.
ex.zh: 一支探險隊前往研究那座冰河。

ex.en: The army sent an expeditionary force overseas.
ex.zh: 軍隊派出遠征部隊前往海外。

ex.en: The gang tried to extort money from the shop owners.
ex.zh: 那幫人想向店家勒索錢財。

ex.en: He was caught trying to extort a bribe from a driver.
ex.zh: 他因試圖向駕駛人敲詐賄款而被逮捕。

ex.en: The manager chose expediency over fairness and picked the fastest option.
ex.zh: 經理選了最快的做法，把方便行事看得比公平重要。

ex.en: Politicians are sometimes accused of acting out of expediency rather than principle.
ex.zh: 政治人物有時被指責是出於權宜而非原則行事。

ex.en: The roller coaster ride exhilarated the children.
ex.zh: 坐雲霄飛車讓孩子們興奮不已。

ex.en: The cold mountain air exhilarated her after the long climb.
ex.zh: 爬了好久之後，山上冷冽的空氣讓她精神為之一振。

ex.en: The workers complained about exploitative wages.
ex.zh: 工人抱怨剝削式的薪資。

ex.en: Critics called the contract exploitative and unfair.
ex.zh: 批評者稱這份合約是剝削且不公平的。

ex.en: She is a regular exerciser who runs every morning.
ex.zh: 她是個固定運動的人，每天早上都跑步。

ex.en: The small exerciser under his desk helps him stay active.
ex.zh: 他桌下的小型健身器材讓他保持活動。

ex.en: We took the expressway to avoid the city traffic.
ex.zh: 我們走高速公路以避開市區的車潮。

ex.en: The new expressway cuts the trip down to one hour.
ex.zh: 新的高速公路把車程縮短到一個小時。

ex.en: Dog excrement on the sidewalk is unpleasant.
ex.zh: 人行道上的狗糞很討人厭。

ex.en: Farmers use animal excrement as fertilizer.
ex.zh: 農民把動物糞便當肥料。

ex.en: The team played excellently in the final match.
ex.zh: 球隊在決賽中表現極為出色。

ex.en: The old machine still works excellently.
ex.zh: 那台老機器仍然運作得非常好。

ex.en: His strange behavior was explicable once we knew about his illness.
ex.zh: 知道他生病後，他奇怪的行為就說得通了。

ex.en: The results are easily explicable by the change in weather.
ex.zh: 這些結果很容易用天氣變化來解釋。

ex.en: Officials decided to exhume the body for further tests.
ex.zh: 官員決定挖出遺體做進一步檢驗。

ex.en: The writer exhumed old letters from the archive to tell the story.
ex.zh: 作者從檔案館挖出舊信件來述說這個故事。

ex.en: The fans exulted when the team scored in the last minute.
ex.zh: 球隊在最後一分鐘得分時，球迷歡欣雀躍。

ex.en: She exulted in her victory and hugged everyone.
ex.zh: 她為自己的勝利欣喜若狂，擁抱了每一個人。

ex.en: The teacher tried to explicate the meaning of the poem.
ex.zh: 老師試著詳細闡釋這首詩的意義。

ex.en: Can you explicate your argument a little more clearly?
ex.zh: 你可以把論點說得更清楚一點嗎？

ex.en: The professor wrote a long exegesis of the ancient poem.
ex.zh: 教授為這首古詩寫了一篇很長的註解。

ex.en: Biblical exegesis requires careful study of the original text.
ex.zh: 聖經釋義需要仔細研讀原文。

ex.en: In an exigency, call the emergency number right away.
ex.zh: 遇到緊急情況，請立刻撥打緊急電話。

ex.en: The exigencies of war forced the city to ration food.
ex.zh: 戰時的緊急需求迫使這座城市實施糧食配給。

ex.en: The report exhaustively covers every part of the problem.
ex.zh: 這份報告詳盡涵蓋了問題的每個部分。

ex.en: They searched the house exhaustively but found nothing.
ex.zh: 他們徹底搜查了整間房子，卻什麼也沒找到。

ex.en: The priest was asked to exorcise the evil spirit.
ex.zh: 人們請神父來驅除惡靈。

ex.en: She wrote a book to exorcise her painful memories.
ex.zh: 她寫了一本書來擺脫痛苦的回憶。

ex.en: The kidneys help the body excrete waste.
ex.zh: 腎臟幫助身體排出廢物。

ex.en: Plants can excrete extra salt through their leaves.
ex.zh: 植物可以透過葉子排出多餘的鹽分。

ex.en: Expressionism is an art style that shows strong feelings.
ex.zh: 表現主義是一種表現強烈情感的藝術風格。

ex.en: The museum has an exhibit on German expressionism.
ex.zh: 博物館有一個德國表現主義的展覽。

ex.en: The forecast is an extrapolation from last year's data.
ex.zh: 這項預測是根據去年數據推斷出來的。

ex.en: Extrapolation can be risky when the trend changes.
ex.zh: 當趨勢改變時，推斷可能有風險。

ex.en: The heat exchanger keeps the building warm.
ex.zh: 熱交換器讓這棟建築保持溫暖。

ex.en: The engineer replaced the broken exchanger in the system.
ex.zh: 工程師換掉了系統中壞掉的交換器。

ex.en: Everyone came except for Tom.
ex.zh: 除了湯姆以外，大家都來了。

ex.en: The room was empty except for a small table.
ex.zh: 除了一張小桌子，房間裡空無一物。
